2026-11-24: Toolkit guide written at skills/csound/SKILL.md from the csound-offline-render evidence (Csound 7.0.0_1, macOS arm64); only the one-sine scored offline render is tested; 7.x vs 6.x syntax differences, random opcodes, real-time and MIDI marked untested.

evidence.result: One sine instrument (poscil, linseg 5 ms attack, 10 ms release), six predeclared notes 220 to 1100 Hz, 0.4 s each, starting at 0 to 2.5 s in 0.5 s steps; f 0 3, sr 48000, ksmps 64, 0dbfs 1; csound -W -o to 16-bit mono WAV: 144000 frames (3.000 s), peak 0.5. Measured frequencies within 0.01 cents of nominal (bound 5 cents); onsets 0.15 to 0.29 ms after start (bound 5 ms); gaps silent; two renders byte-identical (cmp). Spectrogram inspected.
evidence.scope: offline sine score to 16-bit mono 48 kHz WAV; FFT pitch, onset and peak checks; reruns byte-identical; macOS arm64, Homebrew build 7.0.0_1

summary: Programmable sound and music synthesis system with a CLI and embeddable API. Written instruments and scores can produce audio files or be used in realtime; it is not a general video renderer.
use_when: Generate or process audio with a scripted score
Explore synthesis independently of a graphical DAW
avoid_when: Need existing MIDI files rendered with SoundFonts: FluidSynth
license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (core project; verify dependencies and assets)

assessment.rationale: Official site and repository describe sound synthesis, CLI and LGPL terms. The site and development branch differ in 7.0 release status; recent dated activity remains unverified.
